source.statement: hosting and browser acceptance checks passed

releaseDecision: Promote the accepted 2.0.0-rc.3 candidate to stable 2.0.0.
scope: The outstanding hosting and browser acceptance discussed with the user after the rc.3 handoff is accepted as passed. This includes the deployment/offline/update/recovery and browser workflow/output/lifecycle acceptance categories in that handoff.
provenance: This is the user’s acceptance confirmation, not a new agent-observed host inspection or browser run. The user supplied no additional individual browser, device, host log, per-case results or output files in this message.
promotionChangeScope: Release version, release documentation, evidence and exact current-archive selection in the packager. Simulation, editor, storage, model definitions, worker implementation and numerical engine behavior remain the accepted rc.3 implementation.
historicalEvidence: Prior automated, numerical and managed-preview records retain their original rc.3 version/build, observations and hashes. The previous preview limitations remain historical observations and are not current release blockers after owner acceptance.
